title: Pipeline Runtime and Safe Extension
readerIntent: Define, extend, and verify an ordered execution contract.
priorKnowledge: Know the caller, context, nodes, side effects, and failure policy.
summary: The engine loads effective definitions, builds ordered nodes, propagates request/response/process context, and follows explicit success, error, and terminal transitions.

sections.heading: Runtime
items: Load source definitions and governed persisted overrides where supported.
Merge the named definition with pipeline defaults.
Create an instance identity and ordered nodes.
Each node validates required context, performs bounded work, and chooses success, error, or terminal transition.
Enrich failures with safe execution context and preserve the cause.
Update or remove effective definitions only through loader/event governance.

sections.heading: Extension rules
items: Add, replace, disable, or reorder nodes through layered definitions.
Declare input/output mutations, side effects, retry safety, compensation, and timeout.
Use processors as bounded handlers, not hidden pipeline controllers.
Keep durable business state out of in-memory process context.
Test default order, later-module override, repeated execution, partial failure, error path, observability, performance, and consumer regressions.
